title: Fresh-HOME end-to-end: first run needs no file, env var or prompt
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. Run 'susi status', a mock-inference mission and 'susi brain' in an empty HOME with no env and no tty; all must succeed without prompting or writing user-authored config. Integration test zc_fresh_home.rs.
